result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. I changed one condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`. An unmatched contributor is added to the remainder only if `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` is true.

Dormant unmatched contributors are left out. Configured teams are unchanged. A blank latest-commit date already counts as active, because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` returns true for blank input, so nobody is dropped for missing data.

I ran the `codeanalyzer` tests and they passed. I didn't add a test for the new filtering.
